Point the camera at what you want to know about, then use the Ask button to ask a question — for example \"what colour is this?\" Sight Buddy captures the picture as you finish and answers. Ask nothing to simply hear the scene described. After that, use Ask again to ask more about the same picture, or tap Capture for a fresh description. Swipe between features, or use Previous and Next when button navigation is on.

Point the camera at text. Tap Capture to have it read aloud, or use the Ask button to ask a question about it — Sight Buddy captures the picture as you finish and answers. While it reads: tap Play to pause or resume, tap Back or Forward to skip, hold Forward to read faster and hold Back to read slower (the new speed is announced and reading continues), and hold Play to restart from the beginning.
Move the camera slowly. Sight Buddy names the most confident object it sees, with a short pause between announcements so speech stays clear.
Use the Ask button and say what to find, for example \"keys\" or \"cup\". Directional sounds guide you left, right, up, down, or centre. Tap Browse Objects to pick from a list.
Point the camera at the scene. Sight Buddy reports whether lighting is bright, dim, or dark based on the camera image.
Point the camera so the colour fills the small frame in the centre of the screen. Sight Buddy speaks the colour name. Works best in good, even lighting — dim or warm indoor light can shift colours.

Tap the middle Play button to pause or resume the reader. Hold Play to start again from the beginning. A short tap on Back or Forward skips about twenty characters. Hold Forward to read faster, or hold Back to read slower — the new speed is announced and reading continues. You can open this help any time with the Help button.

Do you want to use OpenAI speech recognition for the best user experience? This will enhance the user experience, but will add a minor API cost, about a fraction of a penny per minute of recording time. If enabled, the recorded audio is sent to OpenAI for processing instead of being processed by the system engine. Recommended for users who do not have the voice enhancement models downloaded.
Keep using the system speech recognition

We respect your choice and aim to provide the best solution for your device and needs. Native speech recognition might cut messages off early on some occasions. If you ever want to reconsider, the option is available in settings.
